title: Klarna and Kohl’s team up to bring flexible payment options to U.S. shoppers | Klarna International
body_markdown:
**New York, NY - October 29, 2026** - Klarna, the everyday finance network, is now live at Kohl's, giving U.S. shoppers more flexible ways to pay online and in the Kohl's app.


Starting today, Kohl's customers will now have access to Klarna's flexible payment options at checkout, including pay in full for everyday spending, pay in 4 interest-free installments for mid-size purchases, and financing for bigger-ticket items.


“Customers should be able to shop the way that works best for them, whether that’s paying in full, spreading a purchase over four interest-free payments, or financing a bigger-ticket item,” said Lisa Robinson, Head of Partner Success, US East Coast and Canada at Klarna. “We’re proud to give Kohl’s customers more ways to pay that fit how they shop.”


**About Klarna**


Klarna is the everyday finance network. With over 120 million global active Klarna users and 3.8 million transactions per day, Klarna's AI-powered payments and commerce network is empowering people to pay smarter with a mission to be available everywhere for everything. Consumers can pay with Klarna online, in-store and through Apple Pay & Google Pay. Over 1.2 million retailers trust Klarna's innovative solutions to drive growth and loyalty, including Uber, H&M, Saks, Sephora, Macy's, Ikea, Expedia Group, Nike and Airbnb. Klarna is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: KLAR). For more information, visit


[Klarna.com](https://www.klarna.com/)


.


**About Kohl's**


Kohl’s (NYSE: KSS) is a leading omnichannel retailer built on a foundation that combines great brands, incredible value and convenience for our customers. Kohl’s is uniquely positioned to deliver against its long-term strategy and its purpose to take care of families’ realest moments. Kohl's serves millions of families in its more than 1,100 stores in 49 states, online at Kohls.com, and through the Kohl's App. With a large national footprint, Kohl’s is committed to making a positive impact in the communities it serves. For a list of store locations or to shop online, visit


[Kohls.com](http://kohls.com/)


. For more information about Kohl’s impact in the community or how to join our winning team, visit Corporate.Kohls.com.
